name: artemis-hindsight
description: Chat-with-an-agent webapp: Next.js (UI + agent backend), toolbox, sandbox, Hindsight memory and Postgres, each in its own container.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @artemis/contracts && npm run build -w @artemis/sandbox -w @artemis/toolbox -w @artemis/web
scripts.dev: docker compose -f docker-compose.yml -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build && npm run dev -w @artemis/web
